What a moment they gave. 69'Alejandro Mayorga was looking for the second goal of the match, however after hitting the ball the ball ends up going out of the goal without achieving anything in the opponent's zone. They need more ideas in attack. 66'There are changes for Tigres. Caixinha's team is making adjustments to try and find a goal. Denzell Garcia looked for a way to add a good goal to his personal tally after managing to send a powerful shot from outside the area, but that ball ended up going wide without achieving anything. 59'What a chance! Despite playing with ten men, Tigres continued to create danger up front. The ball was sent into the box after a cross from Ángel Correa, and Vladimir Lorona got a shot off with his left foot, but it went wide. 57'Two substitutions for the home side as they look to create some dangerous moments and retain possession. Guilherme Castilho and Luca Martínez Dupoy came on to try and create scoring opportunities, replacing Rodolfo Pizarro and Jairo Torres. 53'César Araujo looked for a way to create damage in the opposing zone; it is a very lively and contested match between these teams, however, the ball did not manage to generate any danger for the visitors. 49'What a game from the home team, it was Javier Aquino who sent a good ball into the area looking to add a good cross, in the area Alejandro Mayorga appeared with a good shot, but that pass was cleared in a timely manner. 46'The action kicks off for the second half of this important game. It will be a busy and exciting 45 minutes. The home team is expected to get three points and come away with the victory. What a moment . 45+10'The first half ends, the score remains tied at one goal apiece, and both managers have been sent off, leaving Tigres with ten men. It is hoped that the home side will break the deadlock in the second half. 45+7'Jairo Torres manages to unleash a powerful shot towards the goal looking for the second goal for the home team, however the ball ends up hitting the defense, the ball does not go into the goal and the game is not broken. 45+3'After a good cross from Rodolfo Pizarro, Monchu is the player who manages to shoot powerfully at the goal, however the ball ends up going wide without hitting the goal, what a complicated match we are experiencing. 45'There's still time. There were many moments that caused the match to stop, the referee therefore decided to add eight more minutes to this first half, the home team will seek to take the lead. What a game. 42'They're out of the game! After multiple complaints on the bench, the referee decides to send Guido Pizarro and Pedro Caixinha off the game; the coaches never managed to control themselves after Sánchez's strong tackle. 39'Rodolfo Pizarro was looking to get there at full speed to go for those interesting moments that would give his team the opportunity to add the second goal, however it is Diego Lainez who ends up bringing him down in an interesting way. 35'The match is quite heated, both teams are fighting hard for the ball and constantly arguing about every play called against them. They need to keep a cool head; there's still plenty of time. What a moment. 31'He's out of the game! Tigres are down to ten players after the referee reviews Sánchez's foul on Mosquera. The referee determines it was excessive force from the player, a situation that complicates the game for the visitors. 29'VAR! The referee decides to review a strong tackle by Diego Sánchez on Moisés Mosquera using video assistant refereeing. What a moment for the feline team; if it's an expulsion, the game will be much more complicated. 26'Play resumes. After taking some time to rehydrate, the referee decides to continue with the match; it is a back-and-forth duel, with both teams fighting to score more goals. What a moment they are living. 23'What a great defensive cut by Mosquera! The ball would have been crossed by Diego Lainez, but the defender remains very alert and puts his instep in to clear the ball away from danger. It's a very close game. 19'Goal, goal, goal, goal for FC Juárez! What a great moment for the home team! Denzell García was the one who started the whole play for his team. The player unleashed a powerful shot, Estupiñán managed to deflect the ball and it went into Guzmán's goal. 16'It's a constant back-and-forth between both teams. They need to orchestrate dangerous plays for their side. Time is slowly ticking away; the game has barely begun, and little has been seen from either team. 12'The home side continues to clear every ball that the Tigres try to create. Aguirre and company are looking for a way to generate the necessary danger to score a second goal. They need more good ideas . 9'Goal! Goal! Goal! Goal for Tigres! What a great assist Juan Brunetta generated for the visitors, the ball reached the feet of Joaquim Pereira who sent a good header to open the scoring for his team . 7'No goal!
